name: bombermanos
description: Game utilizando react, tailwind, typescript, redis e postgres

scripts.install: npm run install:client && npm run install:login && npm run install:game
scripts.dev:build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix gameserver run build
scripts.dev: npm run dev:check-ports && npm --prefix client run build && npm run dev:build && concurrently -n client,server,gameserver -c cyan,yellow,magenta "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:login" "npm run dev:game"
scripts.dev:vite: npm run dev:check-ports && npm run dev:build && concurrently -n vite,server,gameserver -c cyan,yellow,magenta "npm --prefix client run dev-vite" "npm run dev:login" "npm run dev:game"
scripts.start:game: cd gameserver && npm run build && npm run start
scripts.start:login: cd client && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build && npm run start

author: Luis Gustavo CZP
